correctness.rationale: At the exact parameter \([1:2:4:8]\), substitution in the published \(B_4\) cone formula yields the stated transverse quartic. Exact rational Gröbner bases of its gradient ideal are \([1]\) on all three standard projective patches, proving the base curve smooth. The packaged checker also proves the relevant quartic interpolation space is one-dimensional. Smoothness is open in the parameter, so it persists on a nonempty open set intersecting the published general uniqueness locus. Standard blow-up and adjunction calculations give genus \(3\), \(E^2=-4\), and discrepancy \(-2\).

value.rationale: The \(B_4\) cone is a standard named higher-dimensional unexpected-hypersurface example. Determining that its generic projectivized tangent cone is smooth turns the source's conicality statement into a complete generic singularity classification, including a one-step resolution and discrepancy \(-2\). This identifies a geometrically meaningful singularity boundary rather than merely recomputing the known cone equation.
